title: Errors and troubleshooting
description: Identify connection, authentication, conflict, and Finder integration failures.

sections.title: HTTP errors
paragraphs: Authenticated API failures use an error object with a code. A failed request should be handled explicitly; do not assume a transfer completed because a connection opened.
table: Check the bearer token and server credentials.
Check the ID, expiry, revocation, or trash state.
Refresh metadata and reconcile the new ETag before retrying.
Check the requested bytes against the file size.
Inspect server logs and storage connectivity.

sections.title: Cannot connect
paragraphs: Check /health at the API address. Verify HTTPS, DNS, reverse-proxy routing, and that VITE_API or LOFT_API points at your server rather than localhost on another device.
The public loft website does not expose storage endpoints. Browser account or share pages must belong to your self-hosted installation.

sections.title: Drive missing in Finder
paragraphs: A correctly signed and entitled File Provider installation is required. An ad-hoc source build can pass Swift checks while the Finder domain remains unavailable.

sections.title: Retry deliberately
paragraphs: For interrupted transfers, verify the server’s current metadata and ETag before resuming. A retry after a version conflict must not overwrite a newer file without an explicit decision.
Retain failed uploads for retry. For storage failures, resolve disk capacity, credentials, or S3 connectivity before repeating large requests.
